independence_proof: Verbatim from the board: both rows carry depends_on null/[] - no edge either way. Disjoint file sets, verified on disk at HEAD 6ea9495: RELEASE-001 owns .github/workflows/ci.yml (lines 270/353) + e2e-full-battery.sh (the bcli() wrapper at 362-364); DF-BUNKER-43 owns the CLI exit-code path (internal/cli/status.go, internal/cli/audit*.go, cmd/bunker/main.go) + one new test file. No shared file, no shared package (workflow+bash vs internal/cli), no shared helper. RELEASE-001 is an UNMASKING task (removing continue-on-error) - it deliberately does NOT attempt to make regression green, because making it green requires exactly the harness-binding work that is already owned by the merged INT-CI-025 row; the battery-side binding it adds (bcli target) is the same INT-CI-025 pattern applied to e2e-full-battery.sh. Conflict risk is nil because the two workers never touch the same path.
dispatch_note: Serial merge required: the two branches are merged one at a time, each gated (bash -n / gofmt / go build / go vet / go test) before the next merge. Never a simultaneous merge.
outcome: COMPLETE - both workers landed and both were merged serially with a gate on each. RELEASE-001: ebee2c3 (continue-on-error removed from the regression/root-suite jobs; e2e-full-battery.sh binds BUNKER_SESSION_TARGET, 0->27 markers, plus an explicit --server on every live mutating call site). Verified by the foreman, not self-reported: bash -n clean, --self-test PASS (41 checks), gofmt/build/vet clean, full short suite green, guard PASS non-vacuous. The worker committed to the MAIN worktree rather than its own branch because the brief named the main repo path - the content was verified independently before accepting and no second writer was present. DF-BUNKER-43: 60ca84c, merged ea8a062 (SIGPIPE no longer erases a piped command's exit status). That board row's premise was REFUTED - the foreman's probe read PIPESTATUS after a command substitution, which resets it, so the probe reported 0 for every command; the real defect was the sibling in the opposite direction: audit list | head wrote 324KB and died by signal (141 on 20/20 piped runs) while exiting 0 bare. The foreman ran the falsification control independently (neutering signal.Ignore makes the new table-driven test FAIL; restore byte-identical by sha256 and green again). DF-BUNKER-43's Tier 2 judge returned FAIL on a REAL residual which the foreman reproduced: printAuditTable discards write errors, so a truncated audit list exits 0 instead of 141 - filed as DF-BUNKER-44 rather than silently closed. Both worktree branches removed after merge. MAIN PUSHED via SSH (the https remote's OAuth token lacks workflow scope for ci.yml); remote main parity 0 unpushed. Residual: DF-BUNKER-44; and the full live battery (root + take-over host) was not run, so no VERIFY-PASS is claimed for RELEASE-001.
